name: clocks-band
description: A band above the prompt showing every Bash command, MCP call and subagent that has run for a while, with elapsed time against its limit.

minSeconds.title: Show after (seconds)
minSeconds.description: A call or subagent gets a row once it has run this long.

subagentWarnMinutes.title: Subagent warn time (minutes)
subagentWarnMinutes.description: A subagent row is marked OVER past this time. Advisory: the mod stops nothing.

mcpWarnSeconds.title: MCP call warn time (seconds)
mcpWarnSeconds.description: An MCP call row is marked OVER past this time. Advisory: the mod stops nothing.

bashDefaultLimitSeconds.title: Limit shown for a Bash call with no timeout (seconds)
bashDefaultLimitSeconds.description: 0 shows no limit for a Bash call that carries no timeout of its own.
